stand_in_note: LOCAL STAND-IN, not the Kaggle model. Trained on CPU with a reduced budget (MIT-BIH DS1+DS2 (44 non-paced records, no INCART), 1 seed(s), 6 epochs with SWA over the last 2; the notebook uses 3 seeds x 15 epochs on GPU and adds INCART). It is NOT the model whose metrics are quoted in the BRD (section 8.3); the numbers under 'evaluation' were measured on this machine for this stand-in. Replace beat_model_ts.pt + model_config.json with the Kaggle export to deploy the real one.
architecture: ResNet1D, 2-channel input (beat, beat minus patient template) + 7 RR features; 1-seed ensemble, SWA weights, softmax-averaged
rr_transform: log(clip(x, 0.01, 10)), RR in seconds, causal local means
latency_note: post_rr needs the next beat, so each label is available ~1 beat after the R-peak

training.deployment_data: MIT-BIH 44 non-paced records (DS1 + DS2); INCART not included
training.augmentation: R-peak jitter +-32 ms, NSTDB em/ma/bw noise at 6-30 dB SNR

evaluation_note: Reported metrics come from a separate local model trained on DS1 only (patient-wise, tested on DS2); the shipped stand-in is retrained on DS1+DS2 and has no held-out test of its own. All numbers were measured locally, not copied from the BRD.

evaluation.source: LOCAL STAND-IN measurements (ml/train_local.py on this machine) - not the BRD / Kaggle numbers
evaluation.protocol: patient-wise: trained on MIT-BIH DS1 (22 records, 50981 beats), tested on DS2 (22 unseen records, 49679 beats), cardiologist R-peaks, AAMI N/S/V/F, argmax labels; 1 seed(s) [42], 8 epochs, SWA over last 3

end_to_end.condition: DS2, own R-peak detector, 360 Hz input, labels incl. Unknown threshold (an Unknown beat counts as a miss)

limitations: Local stand-in trained with a reduced CPU budget; expect it to be somewhat weaker than the Kaggle 3-seed ensemble described in the BRD.
Single-lead (MLII / lead II) only; not for ischaemia or 12-lead interpretation.
Supraventricular detection is weak when ectopic beats dominate the rhythm (MIT-BIH record 232); rhythm-level rules (pauses, bradycardia) must cover this case.
Fusion (F) beats are rarely detected on unseen patients.
Not validated on AD8232 recordings yet; research and demonstration use only, not a medical device.
